name: FIFA World Cup Format
definition: The FIFA World Cup format has evolved over time. The current format features 32 teams (expanding to 48 in 2026) competing over a month in the host nation(s). It consists of a group stage followed by a knockout bracket.

history.format: 16 teams (mostly), single group stage followed by knockout rounds.
24 teams, expanded to include a Round of 16.
32 teams, 8 groups of 4, top 2 advance to Round of 16.
48 teams, 12 groups of 4, top 2 plus 8 best third-place teams advance to Round of 32.
